descriptions.agent_stop: Stop a running AI coding agent task. Required: target (project ID or sandbox identifier). Use this to cancel an in-progress agent session when you need to interrupt it, change the prompt, or free up resources. The agent stops immediately without completing any pending work.
descriptions.deployment_auth_disable: Disable HTTP Basic Auth protection on a deployment. Required: project_id. Removes username/password requirement for accessing the deployed site. Use deployment_auth_get first to verify auth is enabled. This makes the deployment publicly accessible.
descriptions.deployment_auth_get: Get the HTTP Basic Auth configuration for a deployment. Required: project_id. Returns whether auth is enabled, and if so, the configured username (password is not returned for security). Use this before setting or disabling auth to understand current state.
descriptions.deployment_domain_get: Get the custom domain configuration for a deployment. Required: project_id. Returns the configured custom domain, www redirect setting, and DNS verification status. Returns null fields if no custom domain is set. Use deployment_subdomain_check to verify availability before setting.
descriptions.deployment_domain_remove: Remove a custom domain from a deployment. Required: project_id. The deployment reverts to its subdomain URL (*.vibecode.dev). DNS records for the custom domain become orphaned and should be cleaned up separately.
descriptions.deployment_links_create: Create a tunnel link to expose a specific port on a deployment. Required: project_id, port (integer). Use for services running on non-standard ports or for debugging. Returns the tunnel URL that forwards to the specified port.
descriptions.deployment_links_list: List all tunnel links for a deployment. Required: project_id. Returns array of links with port numbers and tunnel URLs. Each link exposes one port from the deployment container. Use deployment_links_create to add new links.
descriptions.deployment_subdomain_check: Check if a subdomain is available for use. Required: subdomain (the subdomain name to check, without .vibecode.dev). Returns availability status. Call this before deployment_subdomain_set to avoid conflicts.
descriptions.deployment_subdomain_set: Set the subdomain for a deployment. Required: project_id, subdomain (desired name). The deployment becomes accessible at subdomain.vibecode.dev. Use deployment_subdomain_check first to verify availability. Existing subdomain is replaced.
descriptions.deployments_destroy: Tear down a deployment completely. Required: project_id. Stops the running deployment, removes cloud resources, and releases the subdomain. The project remains but becomes undeployed. Cannot be undone; redeploy with deployments_deploy.
descriptions.deployments_get: Get detailed information about a deployment. Required: project_id. Returns deployment status (building/live/stopped), subdomain, custom domain if set, creation time, and current commit SHA. Use deployments_list when you need all deployments.
descriptions.deployments_list: List all deployments across projects. Optional: limit (max results), query (filter by name). Returns array with project IDs, statuses, subdomains, and URLs. Use deployments_get for full details on a specific deployment.
descriptions.deployments_ready: Check if a deployment is live and responding. Required: project_id. Returns boolean ready status. Use after deployments_deploy to poll for completion, or in health checks. Does not return error details; use deployments_get for status if not ready.
descriptions.projects_create: Create a new Vibecode project. Required: platform (webapp, mobile, or openclaw), description (purpose of the project). Returns the new project ID. After creating, use sandboxes_acquire to start development or deployments_deploy to deploy.
descriptions.projects_delete: Permanently delete a project and all its data. Required: id (project ID). This deletes the project, its sandboxes, deployments, and all history. Cannot be undone. Use projects_get to verify the project first.
descriptions.projects_list: List all projects in the workspace. Optional: limit (max results), query (filter by name). Returns project IDs, names, platforms, and descriptions. Use projects_get for full details including deployment status.
descriptions.sandbox_links_create: Create a tunnel link to expose a port from a sandbox. Required: project_id, port (integer). Use for development access to services running on specific ports. Returns the tunnel URL. Sandbox must be running via sandboxes_acquire.
descriptions.sandboxes_kill: Terminate a running sandbox. Required: project_id. Stops the cloud VM immediately. Unsaved work may be lost. Use for cleanup or when switching to a different development environment. Restart with sandboxes_acquire.
descriptions.sandboxes_list: List all running sandboxes. Optional: limit (max results). Returns sandbox project IDs, statuses, and resource usage. Sandboxes are cloud VMs for development. Use sandboxes_acquire to start one for a project.
descriptions.user_get: Get the current authenticated user's profile. No parameters required. Returns user ID, email, display name, and account settings. Use to verify authentication is working or to get user context for other operations.
